decision.reason: [ev-f0e757e54820] clearly states that the `istioctl profile` command was removed, so change type "removed" is right. The problem is the subject: `profile` is an istioctl subcommand, not a flag. The cli-flag family expects a flag name with a leading `--`, and the sibling item [ev-0307de1909a6] shows commands being removed the same way. None of the available families describes a CLI subcommand, so I can't accept or correct the subject without misclassifying it. This needs a decision on how to model removed subcommands.
